subject.title: Design: run lifecycle reliability — bounded liveness, abort⇒release, crash resume, completion drive

question: Should maintainers adopt this issue as the canonical staged run-lifecycle reliability umbrella, or keep the existing bug-specific reports as the canonical work items?
rationale: The source evidence supports the problem class and VISION.md favors stability work, but the proposed solution chooses lifecycle ownership, liveness policy, persistence, and Codex-wrapper behavior across stable gateway surfaces.

options.title: Adopt staged umbrella
options.body: Approve the four invariants as the maintainer direction and split Track A-D into small implementation issues or PRs with source and live proof.

options.title: Approve Track A only
options.body: Treat abort-to-release and stale takeover as the near-term approved work while deferring durability and completion-drive decisions.

options.title: Keep reports separate
options.body: Decline the umbrella and continue landing narrow fixes against the linked production reports.

recommendation.title: Adopt staged umbrella
recommendation.body: Approve the four invariants as the maintainer direction and split Track A-D into small implementation issues or PRs with source and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: obviyus authored and self-assigned the umbrella and is the clearest owner for deciding whether it should become the canonical design packet.
